headline: 7 gas cylinder blast kills 7 in Ashulia garment factory
summary: At least 20 others were injured as a covered van carrying gas cylinders exploded, sparking a fire that destroyed several vehicles.
details: A devastating gas cylinder explosion and subsequent fire occurred on Sunday evening at a garment factory premises in the Jamgura area of Ashulia, Savar.
At least seven people were killed and approximately 20 others were injured in the incident. Five bodies were recovered from inside the covered van that exploded.
The blast happened around 6:45 PM while gas cylinders were being unloaded from a covered van for use in the factory.
The intensity of the explosion shattered window glass of the factory building and the fire spread to 5-6 other vehicles parked nearby, which were completely destroyed.
One victim, 55-year-old Zainab, was killed when a cylinder flew 200 yards away, pierced the tin roof of a tailor shop, and struck her head.
Fire service units arrived quickly at the scene to bring the fire under control. An investigation into the cause of the accident is currently underway.
Ashulia Industrial Area Police-1 SP Mohammad Mominul Islam Bhuiyan and Ashulia Police Station OC Mohammad Tariqul Islam confirmed the details of the casualties.

The intensity of the explosion shattered window glass of the factory building and the fire spread to 5-6 other vehicles parked nearby, which were completely destroyed.

One victim, 55-year-old Zainab, was killed when a cylinder flew 200 yards away, pierced the tin roof of a tailor shop, and struck her head.

Fire service units arrived quickly at the scene to bring the fire under control. An investigation into the cause of the accident is currently underway.

Ashulia Industrial Area Police-1 SP Mohammad Mominul Islam Bhuiyan and Ashulia Police Station OC Mohammad Tariqul Islam confirmed the details of the casualties.

headline_marked: Case filed against [[MP Gazi Nazrul over second wife’s death]]
headline: Case filed against MP Gazi Nazrul over second wife’s death
summary: The lawmaker's second wife, Mariam Khatun, was found hanging in a flat at NAM Bhaban in Dhaka.
details: A case has been filed against Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and two others on charges of abetting the death of his second wife, Mariam Khatun.
Mariam’s body was recovered from a flat at NAM Bhaban in Dhaka on Saturday night.
The case was filed by Mariam’s father, Masum Billah, with the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station late Sunday night.
Other accused named in the case include the MP's first wife, Maksuda Begum, and Mariam’s maternal uncle, Obaidur Rahman.
Police reported that Gazi Nazrul was present at the flat when the body was recovered.
The MP and his first wife were later taken to the police station for questioning.
According to DC Mizan, the lawmaker has not been arrested as he is subject to certain legal procedures before arrest.
caption:
A lawmaker's second wife found dead in a Dhaka flat; MP Gazi Nazrul and two others now face abetment charges.

A case has been filed against Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and two others on charges of abetting the death of his second wife, Mariam Khatun.

Mariam’s body was recovered from a flat at NAM Bhaban in Dhaka on Saturday night.

The case was filed by Mariam’s father, Masum Billah, with the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station late Sunday night.

Other accused named in the case include the MP's first wife, Maksuda Begum, and Mariam’s maternal uncle, Obaidur Rahman.

Police reported that Gazi Nazrul was present at the flat when the body was recovered.

The MP and his first wife were later taken to the police station for questioning.

According to DC Mizan, the lawmaker has not been arrested as he is subject to certain legal procedures before arrest.

Source: The Daily Star, Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune
